units.source_text: 岛村情不自禁，眼泪都快夺眶而出，就连他自己也惊愕不已。

en.t: Shimamura was overcome, almost ready to burst into tears, and even he himself was astonished.

units.source_text: 此情此景，越发使他觉得这位老人是在同女子告别回家的。

en.t: The scene made him feel all the more that the old man was on his way home after saying goodbye to the woman.
